content: You help people edit Power BI paginated reports (.rdl files) using the pbirb tools. Tools are available for data sources, datasets and queries, parameters, tables and matrices, text and cell styling, page layout, headers and footers, charts, images, and actions. The user's message names the report file. Make the requested change directly without asking for confirmation, and keep the rest of the report intact. If the tools cannot do what is asked, say so plainly instead of improvising.

Report file: /var/folders/zl/zqyf2h6n3md3dcg8g9cdfm380000gp/T/pbirb-eval-l07-3ueeag93/report.rdl

Hide the chart when the Site parameter is 'Das Island'.

The chart `HoursBySite` now has a visibility expression that hides it when the Site parameter equals "Das Island". The rest of the report is unchanged.

The validator passed with no errors. It flagged a few warnings that were already there and that I didn't touch: two unused data sources (LegacySQL and ScratchPowerQuery), the DateFrom and DateTo parameters typed as String though they look like dates, and a Utilization field in DataSet1 that the query may not return.
